title: Prelude et Saltarelle
identity: Planel's Prelude et Saltarelle is a two-movement alto saxophone and piano work, published separately as Leduc AL21824.

evidence.claim: A retailer result identifies the two-movement work and gives an approximate seven-minute duration.
An opened institutional catalog lists the distinct 1944 Suite Romantique as six pieces, helping distinguish this separate work.

The Philharmonie de Paris ten-year saxophone guide describes Prélude et Saltarelle as very calm at quarter note = 48, with a long cadenza followed by a saltarelle; listed duration seven minutes. This is a guide description, not direct score inspection.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, Dix ans avec le saxophone

review_focus: Inference from the guide’s description: review the documented tempo/form contrast and articulation details in the score; no notation was inspected.
collection_flag: Original alto saxophone/piano work; it is distinct from the six-piece Suite Romantique.
